children: China's Standing Committee of the National People's Congress has adopted a law to combat cross-border corruption, state news agency Xinhua said on Friday.
The law is aimed at preventing and punishing cross-border corruption, deepening international anti-corruption cooperation and safeguarding China's sovereignty and security, the report said.
